svg.title: MPU architecture with four ACIM arrays and eight planned DarkRISCV processor cores
svg.desc: A CPU submits commands and activations through MMIO. A four-entry command FIFO feeds a sequencer. A weight tile buffer loads external packed weights. Four Lab 1 ACIM macros process shared activations, producing 32 ADC codes that digital accumulators turn into signed INT32 results. Result memory feeds MMIO readback. The planned programmable vector processing unit sits inside the MPU after projection writeback. The sequencer launches a kernel dispatcher. Eight DarkRISCV cores with private program counters fetch shared kernel code and access banked tensor memory.
